# teams_settings_custom_app (Data Source)

Look up an existing SettingsCustomApp object. Set identity to select it.

## Schema

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

- `is_sideloaded_apps_interaction_enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -isSideloadedAppsInteractionEnabled parameter.
